body.name: Counted Qty
body.description: On a Count edited row (#678), the quantity of Material counted at Address on Job — what the edit set the stock there to, in the material's Unit, 0 or more. The count before the edit is Counted Qty less Qty. Blank on every other event.

body.name: Notes
body.description: On a Count edited row (#678), what the person editing the count wrote about it, if anything. Blank on every other event.

The change to the stock of Material at Address on Job, in the material's Unit: negative where stock left the address (Issued, Sent), positive where it came in (Received, Send canceled), and either on a Count edited row (#678), whose Qty is its Counted Qty less the stock before it. A WRITTEN OFF ROW IS THE ONE EXCEPTION (#677): it moves no address's stock, since what it writes off left its address with the Sent row and never reached another, so its Qty is what it took out of transit, negative, and the stock leaves it out (lib/materialStock.js) — only what is in transit counts it (lib/materialTransit.js).

before: The change to the stock of Material at Address on Job, in the material's Unit: negative where stock left the address (Issued, Sent), positive where it came in (Received, Send canceled). A WRITTEN OFF ROW IS THE ONE EXCEPTION (#677): it moves no address's stock, since what it writes off left its address with the Sent row and never reached another, so its Qty is what it took out of transit, negative, and the stock leaves it out (lib/materialStock.js) — only what is in transit counts it (lib/materialTransit.js).

body.description: The day it happened, as the person recording it gave it — on a Sent row the day it was sent, on a Received row the day it arrived (#677) — not when it was recorded, which is Recorded At. A Send canceled, Written off or Count edited (#678) row holds the day it was recorded, in the recorder's own zone.
